description: Search the American Adventurer records of public-land camps by name or place word, state, cost (free, fee, unpriced, license) and water. Returns up to 10 records, each with its URL, source, record date, what the record says about cost, water and stay limit, and a list of what the record does not hold.

q.description: A camp or place name word, like "hyalite".

water.description: True to keep only camps whose record names water.

name: find_camps
title: Find public-land camps
